stories.title: How AI Farm Advice on SMS, Voice and WhatsApp Is Reaching African Farmers
stories.synopsis: Simple AI tools that work in local languages, over text, voice calls and WhatsApp, are helping fill a big gap in farm advice, since Kenya has just one extension officer for about 1,100 farm households. Ghana's Darli AI reached 110,000 farmers in more than 27 languages within eight months, and farmers don't even need to read or write to use it. The article notes the services work best when tied to trusted people like cooperatives or extension officers.

stories.title: AI in science: every researcher now has an AI lab assistant. What that means.
stories.synopsis: This roundup shows how AI is speeding up discovery in labs. Google DeepMind's GNoME found 2.2 million new crystal structures, including 52,000 novel lithium-ion conductors, and outside researchers have already made 736 of those predicted materials in the lab. A materials science study also found AI-assisted teams discovered 44% more compounds with measurably better properties.

stories.title: AI helps uncover critical flaw in widely used internet software amid cyber arms race
stories.synopsis: Amid scary headlines about AI's risks, security researchers put AI's abilities to good use by uncovering a severe flaw in Java before it was too late. It's a reassuring sign that AI can help defenders keep widely used internet software safer for everyone.
